description: This file provides declarations for general input/output utility functions and macros related to GPIO pin handling, including pin mode setting, pin reading, and ICU start functions, with some unused code for LED displays.

methods.name: efiSetPadMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of a specified pin, primarily used to configure GPIO pin modes.

methods.name: efiReadPin
methods.description: Reads the current state of a specified GPIO pin.

methods.name: getInputMode
methods.description: Returns the input mode configuration for a specified pin mode.

methods.name: efiIcuStart
methods.description: Starts the ICU driver with the provided configuration; conditionally included based on HAL_USE_ICU macro.
